Job description 
 Job Title: Telesales Executive New Sales & Renewals Company: Mealawe
 Location: Pune | Work from Office
 Experience: 2 to 5 years
 Annual CTC: 3 to 6 lakh, depending on experience and interview performance, plus performance-based incentives linked to new customer sales and subscription renewals.

 About Mealawe (A Unit of Yagy Tech Pvt Ltd) Mealawe makes everyday eating convenient with homely meals and flexible meal subscriptions. Were looking for a customer-focused Telesales Executive to convert enquiries into paid orders, drive subscription renewals and build lasting customer relationships. 

 What You'll Do Connect with prospective customers through calls and WhatsApp to understand their meal requirements. Explain meal plans, subscription options, pricing and offers, and help customers choose a suitable plan. Convert enquiries, trial users and interested leads into paying customers through timely follow-ups. Contact customers before their subscriptions expire and drive timely renewals. Handle objections around pricing, food preferences and service experience with clear, accurate information. Coordinate with customer support and operations teams to resolve issues affecting conversions or renewals. Maintain accurate records of calls, customer feedback, follow-ups and sales in the CRM. Meet agreed targets for new sales, renewals, collections and customer retention.

Confidence in handling inbound and outbound calls, explaining products and closing sales. A disciplined approach to follow-ups and managing multiple customer conversations. Ability to listen, handle objections and sell without overpromising. Comfort working with CRM tools, WhatsApp and basic Excel or Google Sheets. Experience in food delivery, consumer services or other subscription businesses is an advantage. Willingness to work full-time from our Pune office. 

 How Success Will Be Measured New customer conversions and sales revenue. Subscription renewal rate and renewal revenue. Reactivation of lapsed customers. Follow-up completion and CRM accuracy. Quality of customer conversations and feedback. 

 Why Join Mealawe? Take ownership of the complete customer sales journeyfrom the first enquiry to repeat subscriptionsand work closely with a growing consumer food brand.

title: Walk-in || Customer aquisation associate
description:

Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM

JOB DESCRIPTION 
 CUSTOMER ACQUISITION ASSOCIATE 
 Company: Weather Fighter Pvt. Ltd.
 Department: Customer Acquisition / Business Development
 Designation: Customer Acquisition Associate
 Reporting To: Senior Customer Acquisition Associate / Customer Acquisition Manager / Market Growth Manager
 Location: Pune 
 Employment Type: Full-Time

 1. JOB PURPOSE 
The Customer Acquisition Associate is responsible for generating new business leads, contacting potential customers, understanding their requirements, qualifying prospects, arranging customer meetings and site visits, and supporting the sales team in converting leads into business opportunities.
The role will primarily focus on B2B customer acquisition for Weather Fighter's industrial waterproofing, epoxy flooring, PU flooring, protective coatings, construction chemicals, and related services.
The employee will be an important first point of contact between the company and prospective customers.

 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 A. Lead Generation 
Generate new business leads through:
 Outbound calling Existing customer database IndiaMART Justdial Sulekha LinkedIn Google/business directories Website enquiries WhatsApp Email References Contractor networks Architect/consultant networks Exhibitions and events Project databases Market research Identify potential B2B customers and initiate contact. Introduce Weather Fighter and its relevant products/services. Generate qualified enquiries for the sales and technical team. 
 3. OUTBOUND CALLING 
 Make regular outbound calls to potential customers. Contact industries, factories, builders, contractors, architects, consultants, purchase teams, facility managers, project managers, and other relevant decision-makers. Introduce the company professionally. Understand customer requirements through appropriate questions. Identify upcoming or ongoing projects. Explain the company's relevant services. Generate interest and arrange further discussions. Maintain professional telephone etiquette. Follow the approved company calling process and communication standards. 
 4. CUSTOMER REQUIREMENT IDENTIFICATION 
Understand whether the customer has requirements related to:
 Industrial Waterproofing Epoxy Flooring PU Flooring Industrial Flooring Protective Coatings Anti-Corrosive Coatings Heat-Insulation Coatings Fire-Retardant Coatings Electrical Insulation Coatings Construction Chemicals Waterproofing Chemicals & Membranes Sealants Epoxy Grouts Tile Adhesives Customized Coating Solutions Collect basic information regarding:
 Type of requirement Project location Project stage Approximate area/quantity Expected timeline Customer/company details Decision-maker details Current supplier, where applicable Expected next action 
 5. LEAD QUALIFICATION 
Evaluate leads based on:
 Customer 
 Company name Contact person Designation Mobile number Email ID Location Industry Requirement 
 Product/service required Project type Project location Requirement quantity/area Project stage Expected purchase timeline Opportunity 
 Budget/potential value where available Decision-maker Contractor/consultant involvement Probability of conversion Only relevant and properly qualified leads should be transferred to the concerned sales/technical team.

 6. APPOINTMENT GENERATION 
 Schedule meetings between customers and the sales/technical team. Arrange site visits where required. Confirm appointments with customers. Share complete customer and project information with the concerned executive. Follow up after meetings. Record meeting outcomes in CRM. Schedule the next follow-up/action. 
 7. LEAD FOLLOW-UP 
 Follow up with all qualified leads according to the defined schedule. Contact prospects through calls, WhatsApp, or email. Follow up on customer requirements. Track project timelines. Reconnect with future prospects when the project becomes active. Reactivate old and inactive leads. Ensure no qualified lead is neglected. Escalate high-potential leads to the reporting manager. 
 8. CUSTOMER DATABASE MANAGEMENT 
 Create and maintain an accurate customer database. Research potential companies and decision-makers. Collect relevant contact information. Categorize prospects according to: City Industry Customer type Project type Requirement Lead status 
 Remove duplicate or irrelevant records. Continuously expand the prospect database. 
 9. CRM MANAGEMENT 
CRM/software usage is mandatory.
The employee must:
 Enter every new lead into CRM. Update customer details. Record calls and conversations. Record requirements. Update lead status. Enter next follow-up date. Record appointments. Update meeting/site-visit information. Maintain accurate lead sources. Update transferred leads. Maintain daily CRM discipline. Suggested Lead Flow 
 New Lead Contacted Connected Interested Qualified Appointment Site Visit Technical Discussion Quotation Negotiation Order / Future Follow-up / Lost 

 10. SALES TEAM COORDINATION 
 Transfer qualified leads to the appropriate sales executive. Provide complete customer and project information. Coordinate meetings and site visits. Share customer requirements with the technical team. Follow up with the sales team regarding lead progress. Ensure proper handover of every qualified opportunity. Support the sales team with additional customer information when required. 
 11. MARKET & PROJECT RESEARCH 
 Identify potential construction and industrial projects. Search for companies requiring industrial flooring, waterproofing, coatings, or construction chemicals. Identify relevant contractors, builders, architects, and consultants. Collect basic project information. Add potential projects to the CRM/database. Share promising opportunities with the reporting manager. 
 12. CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP DEVELOPMENT 
Maintain professional relationships with:
 Industrial companies Builders Contractors Architects Consultants Facility managers Purchase departments Project managers Dealers and distributors Applicators The objective is to create long-term business relationships and future sales opportunities .

 13. DAILY WORK RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Morning 
 Review new leads. Review pending follow-ups. Prepare daily calling plan. Prioritize high-potential leads. During Working Hours 
 Outbound calls. Lead generation. Customer qualification. Appointment generation. Follow-ups. Database research. Customer communication. CRM updates. Coordination with sales/technical teams. End of Day 
 Update CRM. Complete pending follow-ups. Update lead status. Submit daily activity report. Prepare the next day's follow-up plan. 
 14. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) 
Performance will be measured on:
 Lead Generation 
 Number of new leads generated. Number of qualified leads. Lead quality. New companies identified. Calling 
 Daily outbound calls. Connected calls. Meaningful conversations. Follow-up calls. Customer Acquisition 
 Qualified opportunities generated. New customer meetings. Site visits generated. Sales opportunities created. Conversion Support 
 Lead-to-qualified-lead conversion. Appointment-to-opportunity conversion. Opportunities converted to sales. CRM 
 Daily CRM updates. Accurate customer data. Follow-up discipline. Reporting accuracy. 
 15. QUALIFICATION 
 Preferred Qualification 
 Graduate in any discipline. BBA / B.Com / BA / B.Sc. or equivalent qualification preferred. Diploma/degree in Civil Engineering or a technical field will be an advantage. 
 16. EXPERIENCE 
 Preferred Experience: 02 years 
Experience in:
 Telecalling Customer Acquisition B2B Sales Lead Generation Business Development Inside Sales Construction Chemicals Building Materials Waterproofing Flooring Paints & Coatings will be an advantage.
 Freshers may also be considered if they demonstrate strong communication skills, confidence, willingness to learn, and a target-oriented approach.

 17. REQUIRED SKILLS 
 Communication 
 Good verbal communication. Professional telephone etiquette. Basic email and WhatsApp communication. Ability to speak confidently with customers. Sales 
 Lead generation. Prospecting. Customer qualification. Follow-up. Appointment setting. Relationship building. Basic convincing skills. Computer 
 Basic MS Excel. MS Word. Email. CRM/software. Internet research. WhatsApp Business. Basic data entry. 
 18. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES 
The ideal candidate should be:
 Energetic. Confident. Proactive. Target-oriented. Good at communication. Persistent with follow-ups. Customer-focused. Organized. Self-motivated. Comfortable with outbound calling. Willing to learn. Able to handle rejection positively. Responsible for daily reporting. 
 19. ROLE EXPECTATION 
The Customer Acquisition Associate is expected to take ownership of the first stage of the customer journey:
 Identify Contact Understand Qualify Follow Up Schedule Meeting Handover Track 
The employee should focus on generating genuine and qualified business opportunities , not merely increasing the number of calls.

 20. CAREER GROWTH 
 Customer Acquisition Associate 

 Senior Customer Acquisition Associate 

 Customer Acquisition Team Leader / Manager 

 Market Growth Associate 

 Market Growth Officer 

 Project Growth Manager 

 Regional Growth & Operations Head 

 Zonal Growth Head / Business Head 

 21. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 
The ideal candidate should have a strong communication ability, positive attitude, customer-handling skills, disciplined follow-up approach, and willingness to work towards measurable targets .
The person should be comfortable with regular outbound calling and should have the ability to identify genuine customer requirements and convert them into qualified opportunities for the company's sales and technical teams.
 Core Success Formula 
 Calling + Lead Generation + Qualification + Follow-up + Appointment + CRM Discipline = Customer Acquisition

 Company: BlueMaarlin

The candidate should have experience in identifying new business opportunities, developing customer relationships, generating inquiries, and converting leads into orders. The candidate will be responsible for handling both OEM sales and end-user sales , regularly visiting customers, understanding their technical requirements, preparing basic proposals and quotations, conducting follow-ups, and achieving business development targets across Maharashtra. The ideal candidate must have good market knowledge, excellent communication and convincing skills, and the ability to professionally represent the company in front of customers. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Development & Market Expansion Identify and develop new business opportunities across Maharashtra. Generate new customers, inquiries, and sales leads through field visits, market research, references, networking, and other business development activities. Develop and maintain relationships with OEMs, EPC contractors, consultants, industrial customers, dealers, and end users. Identify potential customers and convert business opportunities into qualified leads and sales inquiries. Expand the company's customer base and develop long-term business relationships. 2. OEM Sales & End-User Sales Independently handle OEM sales as well as direct end-user sales. Understand the requirements of OEMs, consultants, project contractors, and industrial clients. Develop new OEM accounts and maintain regular communication with existing customers. Visit industrial end users to understand their requirements and identify potential applications for the company's products. Coordinate with customers, internal technical teams, and management to develop suitable solutions. Follow up on ongoing projects, upcoming requirements, and repeat business opportunities. 3. Customer Visits & Field Activities Work in the field for 4 days per week and in the office for 2 days per week . Plan regular customer visits and maintain an organized field visit schedule. Take appointments before visiting customers and ensure productive meetings. Conduct frequent customer visits in Pune and Mumbai , along with planned visits to Nashik, Nagpur, and Sambhajinagar. Meet customers to discuss technical requirements, ongoing projects, new inquiries, quotations, and order status. Build strong customer relationships through consistent communication and regular visits. Submit daily visit reports and update management on customer meetings, business opportunities, and next action plans. 4. Lead Generation & Lead Qualification Generate leads through customer visits, market research, references, networking, and available business platforms. Evaluate and filter leads based on customer requirements, project status, purchase potential, budget, and business feasibility. Identify genuine inquiries and prioritize high-potential customers and projects. Maintain an updated database of customers, contacts, inquiries, and sales opportunities. Track leads from initial contact through inquiry generation, quotation, negotiation, and order conversion. 5. Technical Sales & Product Understanding Develop a strong understanding of the company's products, applications, specifications, and technical capabilities. Understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate products or solutions. Handle basic technical discussions and respond confidently to customer queries. Address technical doubts professionally and coordinate with the technical team whenever detailed engineering inputs are required. Explain product features, benefits, specifications, and commercial advantages to customers. Understand customer drawings, technical specifications, and project requirements to the extent necessary for effective technical sales. Continuously improve product knowledge and technical selling skills. 6. Quotations, Proposals & Commercial Negotiations Prepare basic technical proposals and commercial quotations as per customer requirements. Coordinate with the backend sales, proposal, and technical teams for complex or customized inquiries. Follow up on submitted quotations and proposals until closure. Handle commercial discussions, price negotiations, and customer objections within the company's approved commercial policies. Convince customers by explaining the value, quality, technical suitability, and commercial benefits of the company's offerings. Monitor quotation status, order possibilities, and reasons for lost business. Work towards converting inquiries into confirmed orders and achieving sales targets. 7. Customer Follow-Ups & Communication Conduct regular follow-ups through telephone calls, emails, WhatsApp, and customer visits. Ensure timely communication with customers regarding inquiries, quotations, technical clarifications, and project updates. Send a weekly broadcast message to relevant customers regarding new inquiries, upcoming projects, product updates, and other relevant business opportunities. Maintain professional communication and ensure no important inquiry or customer follow-up is missed. Send appointment requests and coordinate meeting schedules with customers. Maintain a structured follow-up system for all active leads and pending quotations. 8. Reporting & Internal Coordination Submit daily reports to the reporting manager covering customer visits, meetings, calls, inquiries generated, follow-ups, and next action plans. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, lead status, quotations, and order progress. Share regular updates regarding new projects, market developments, competitor activities, and customer feedback. Coordinate with management and internal teams for quotations, technical clarifications, pricing approvals, and order processing. Provide a weekly summary of business development activities, lead conversion status, and upcoming opportunities. Ensure timely and transparent reporting of all sales activities. Required Skills & Qualifications Relevant educational background in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical field. Prior experience in field sales, technical sales, industrial sales, or business development is mandatory. Experience in OEM sales and end-user sales is strongly preferred. Good understanding of industrial markets, customer acquisition, lead generation, and sales conversion. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Hindi, Marathi, and English . Strong negotiation, convincing, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to understand technical products and explain their applications to customers. Good email writing, telephone etiquette, and professional communication skills. Basic working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and email. Ability to prepare basic proposals, quotations, and customer reports. Strong follow-up discipline, time management, planning, and organizational skills. Willingness to travel frequently across Maharashtra. Work Schedule & Company Support Field work: 4 days per week. Office work: 2 days per week. Primary markets: Pune and Mumbai, with regular planned visits to Nashik, Nagpur, and Sambhajinagar. Travel: Frequent intercity travel as required for customer meetings and business development.  Role Overview We are looking for a target-oriented and relationship-driven Sales Executive to drive customer acquisition, generate leads, close sales, and manage customer relationships across Pune, Mumbai, and Thane. The role involves field sales, on-ground lead generation, relationship building, and customer retention in a premium service environment. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, empathy, and the ability to build lasting relationships with families, senior citizens, doctors, residential societies, and referral partners. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Sales & Business Development Generate and close B2C and B2B sales through direct outreach and relationship-based selling. Conduct in-person and virtual meetings with prospective customers, corporate clients, and residential society representatives. Explain service offerings, pricing, and value propositions effectively. Manage sales pipelines, conduct timely follow-ups, and achieve monthly revenue targets. Maintain accurate CRM records, including lead status, deal value, meeting notes, and next steps. 
 2. Lead Generation & Field Activities Generate qualified leads through residential societies, senior citizen associations, doctor referrals, hospitals, NRI networks, and community organisations. Conduct on-ground promotional activities, awareness drives, and local events. Undertake cold calling, door-to-door outreach, and other prospecting activities where required. Develop and maintain strong referral networks within assigned territories. Meet monthly self-generated lead targets and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

Address customer concerns proactively and ensure a positive customer experience. Identify opportunities for upselling and offering additional services. Support customer retention initiatives and minimise churn.

Ensure proper documentation and timely collection of customer information. Monitor customer concerns and escalate service gaps or sensitive issues to the reporting manager. Maintain high standards of professionalism and customer engagement. 
 5. Reporting & Performance Management Maintain accurate CRM data and timely sales reports. Participate in regular sales reviews and performance discussions. Track sales targets, lead conversions, renewals, and pipeline performance. Follow established sales processes and reporting standards. 
 Required Experience & Qualifications 2+ years of experience in sales, business development, or customer acquisition. Bachelors degree is mandatory. Experience in field sales and relationship-based selling is preferred. Candidates from healthcare, elder care, insurance, medical services, or related industries will be preferred. Familiarity with CRM tools and structured sales processes is an advantage. 
 Required Skills Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Strong relationship-building abilities and customer-centric thinking. Empathy, emotional intelligence, and maturity in handling sensitive situations. Target-driven approach with strong follow-up and time-management skills. Comfortable with extensive fieldwork, local travel, and on-ground activations. Fluency in English and relevant local languages. High integrity, professionalism, and accountability. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Monthly and annual revenue target achievement. Number of self-generated leads. Lead-to-conversion ratio. Customer renewal and retention rates. Reduction in customer churn. CRM accuracy and reporting discipline. Customer satisfaction and feedback.

title: Spare Parts Manager / Maintenance Inventory Manager
description:
1. Purpose of the Role: To ensure uninterrupted availability of spare parts, consumables, and maintenance materials for Forging, Machining, and Facility equipment by developing and managing an efficient maintenance inventory system. Responsible for spare parts planning, inventory optimization, procurement coordination, vendor management, warehouse control, and SAP inventory management to support plant reliability and operational excellence. 
 2. Responsibilities: a. Function Specific Manage end-to-end spare parts inventory for Forging, Machining, Utilities, and Facility equipment. Ensure availability of critical spare parts for production-critical machines and utilities. Develop and maintain spare parts inventory strategy based on equipment criticality and business risk. Classify spares into Critical, Insurance, Operational, and Consumable categories. Establish Min-Max stock levels and Reorder Point systems for all maintenance inventories. Monitor inventory levels and prevent stock-outs of critical items. Coordinate with Maintenance, Purchase, Production, and Finance departments for inventory planning. Maintain accurate spare part master data in SAP. Prepare annual spare parts budget and monitor inventory spending. Manage inventory valuation, stock turnover, and inventory optimization initiatives. Conduct critical spare part reviews with maintenance teams. Develop spare part standardization and interchangeability programs. Coordinate procurement of local and imported spare parts. Follow-up with OEMs and suppliers for timely delivery of critical items. Evaluate and develop alternate suppliers wherever possible. Monitor spare part consumption trends and forecast future requirements. Support preventive maintenance shutdowns through spare parts readiness. Conduct periodic stock verification and inventory audits. Ensure compliance with internal controls and inventory management procedures. Maintain spare part documentation, catalogues, drawings, technical specifications, and equipment BOMs. Support machine reliability programs through effective spare parts availability. Lead inventory reduction and cost optimization projects without affecting plant reliability. b. Key Equipment Coverage 1. Forging Shop Equipment Mechanical Presses Hydraulic Presses Induction Heating Systems Furnaces Shot Blasting Machines Trimming Presses MPI Machines Sawing Machines Manipulators Automation Systems 2.Machine Shop Equipment CNC Machines VMC Machines HMC Machines Nachi Transfer Machines Washing Machines Gantry Systems Automation Equipment Tool Presetters Coolant Filtration Systems 3.Utilities & Facility Equipment Air Compressors Cooling Towers Water Distribution Systems DG Sets Transformers PCC / MCC Panels Fire Fighting Systems HVAC Systems Pumps ETP/STP Systems c. Environment Health and Safety Ensure safe storage and handling of maintenance materials and spare parts. Follow EHS guidelines for storage of oils, lubricants, chemicals, batteries, and hazardous materials. Maintain warehouse safety standards and housekeeping practices. Ensure compliance with statutory and company requirements related to inventory storage. Support sustainability and waste reduction initiatives. d. Operational Excellence (OpEx) Look for waste in the process or activity performed with the intent of elimination. Ensure that the workplace is maintained in a neat and clean manner. Participate in Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives. e. Energy Management System Requirement Support efficient inventory planning for energy-related equipment. Ensure availability of spare parts required for energy-efficient operation of utilities and production equipment. Support ISO 50001 requirements through equipment reliability management. Promote sustainable procurement and inventory practices. 
 3. Authorities: Define stock levels and inventory policies for maintenance spares. Recommend procurement of critical and strategic spare parts. Coordinate emergency purchases during breakdown situations. Approve spare part specifications and inventory classifications. Lead inventory audits and corrective actions. Escalate critical shortages impacting production or utilities. Recommend obsolete inventory disposal and inventory optimization actions. 
 4. Requirements of profile: a. Education / Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Supply Chain Management. Diploma holders with strong maintenance inventory experience may also be considered. Certification in Supply Chain Management, Inventory Management, SAP MM, SAP PM, or Warehouse Management preferred. b. Number of years of past Work Experience: Lead Spare Parts Manager: 8-10 Years c. It runs its own fiber network serving thousands of homes and businesses across Pimpri Chinchwad and Pune, and offers FTTH broadband, Internet Leased Lines, SD-WAN, managed firewall and enterprise telecom solutions. The client is building a high-performance inside sales desk and wants people who can close on the phone. The Role You will be the voice of the brand. You will work inbound leads (website, Google, Meta ads, WhatsApp, IVR, walk-in enquiries) and run outbound calling campaigns to convert prospects into paying customers – over phone, WhatsApp, email and video call. No field travel. You close B2C broadband end-to-end from the desk, and you qualify, pitch and close B2B connectivity deals (ILL, SD-WAN, telecom products) with support from the solutions and field teams. Key Responsibilities A. B2C Broadband (FTTH) Respond to every inbound lead within 5 minutes – calls, WhatsApp, web forms and ad leads. Check feasibility, recommend the right plan (speed, OTT bundle, tenure) and close the sale on call. Collect KYC documents and advance payment digitally (UPI / payment link) and book the installation slot. Upsell 6/12-month prepaid plans and higher speeds; run renewal, win-back and referral calling campaigns on the existing base. Follow up until activation is complete and the customer is happy. B. B2B / Enterprise (ILL, SD-WAN & Telecom Products) Run outbound calling, email and LinkedIn / WhatsApp sequences to SMEs, factories, offices, hospitals, schools and IT parks in Pune and PCMC. Qualify requirements: bandwidth, number of locations, current ISP, uptime needs, budget and decision-maker. Pitch Internet Leased Line (1:1 dedicated bandwidth), business broadband, SD-WAN, MPLS / P2P, static IPs, SIP trunk / IP-PBX / VoIP, managed Wi-Fi and managed firewall. Coordinate feasibility with the network team, prepare quotations and proposals, run virtual demos / video meetings and close deals. For large or multi-location deals, book qualified meetings for the field / key account team and co-own the closure. Follow through on PO, CAF / KYC documentation, activation and first invoice collection. C. CRM & Reporting Log every call, lead status and next step in the CRM (Zoho) – no lead left without a follow-up date. Share daily call and conversion reports; give feedback to marketing on lead quality. Daily / Monthly KPIs 80–100 calls per day; 2.5+ hours of talk time. Inbound lead response time: under 5 minutes. B2C: 50 new broadband activations per month (Executive) / 70 (Senior Executive). B2B: 15 qualified meetings / demos per month and 75,000 new Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) per quarter (Executive) / 1,50,000 (Senior Executive). Lead-to-sale conversion of 20%+ on inbound broadband leads; 100% CRM updates. Who You Are Graduate in any discipline. 1–5 years in inside sales, tele-sales or inbound sales – broadband, ISP, telecom, SaaS or IT services preferred. Confident, clear communicator on the phone; can handle objections and close without meeting the customer. Understands or can quickly learn bandwidth, ILL vs broadband, static IP, uptime SLA, SD-WAN and failover basics. Fluent in Marathi, Hindi and English; good written English for email and WhatsApp. Comfortable with CRM, dialer, WhatsApp Business, Excel / Google Sheets. Target-driven, disciplined and consistent. Compensation – Fixed Salary Inside Sales Executive: 2.4 – 3.6 LPA fixed Senior Inside Sales Executive: 3.6 – 5.4 LPA fixed Final fixed pay based on experience and current CTC. Accelerator: 100–149% of monthly target = 1.25x on all activations; 150%+ = 1.5x on all activations. Gate: incentives start at 60% of monthly target. 2.  Location: Pune

 Rotational Shifts 
 Job Description: 
 Distacart is looking for confident, customer-focused, and result-oriented Customer Retention & Telecalling Executives to join our Pune team. The role involves connecting with international customers who have shown interest in purchasing from Distacart, including customers with abandoned carts, previous customers, and other retention opportunities. The ideal candidate should have excellent spoken English, strong communication skills, active listening abilities, and the confidence to interact professionally with international customers over calls. This role is not limited to telecalling. The executive will also be responsible for maintaining customer data, updating Excel/CRM trackers, documenting customer feedback, supporting sales conversions, and sharing customer insights with the Team Lead and management. Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Calling & Cart Recovery Contact customers who have added products to their cart but have not completed their purchase. Understand the reasons behind cart abandonment or purchase hesitation. Assist customers with product availability, pricing, payment, delivery, and ordering-related queries. Guide interested customers toward completing their purchases. Follow up with potential customers as required. Maintain a professional, polite, and consultative approach during every interaction. 2. Customer Retention & Engagement Connect with existing and previous Distacart customers to encourage repeat purchases. Understand customer requirements, preferences, and buying behavior. Build positive customer relationships through regular and meaningful communication. Identify opportunities for future purchases. Re-engage dormant or inactive customers as assigned. Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the interaction. 3. Sales & Conversion Work toward defined daily, weekly, and monthly calling and conversion targets. Identify genuine purchase opportunities during customer conversations. Encourage customers to complete purchases without using aggressive sales techniques. Follow up systematically with interested customers. Maintain accurate records of converted, interested, follow-up, and non-converted customers. 4. Customer Feedback & Issue Identification Understand and accurately document customer concerns and feedback. Identify common reasons for cart abandonment and incomplete purchases. Highlight recurring issues related to products, payments, delivery, website experience, or customer service. Escalate important concerns to the Team Lead or relevant internal teams. Share customer insights that can help improve customer experience and conversion rates. 5. Data & Excel/CRM Management Maintain daily calling and customer interaction records. Update customer status, call outcomes, follow-up dates, and remarks accurately. Maintain customer data hygiene and ensure records are updated regularly. Update daily and weekly performance trackers. Document customer conversations and outcomes properly. Avoid duplicate, incorrect, or incomplete customer records. 6. Reporting & Management Updates Regularly share updates with the Team Lead and management on: Calls completed and customers connected. Follow-ups generated and orders converted. Customer retention opportunities. Common customer concerns and product-related queries. Reasons for cart abandonment. Customer insights and recurring trends. Coordinate with relevant internal teams to support faster issue resolution and improve customer satisfaction. Required Skills & Qualifications Excellent spoken English and strong verbal communication skills. Clear pronunciation and professional telephone etiquette. Confidence in communicating with international customers. Strong listening and comprehension skills. Customer-focused approach with a positive attitude. Good persuasion, negotiation, and sales conversion skills. Ability to build customer relationships and handle objections professionally. Basic to intermediate knowledge of MS Excel and CRM tools. Good data management, documentation, and reporting skills. Ability to work toward daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets. Prior experience in international voice process, telecalling, telesales, customer retention, or customer support is preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates with experience handling international customers over calls. Candidates with excellent English communication and strong customer-handling skills. Candidates who are comfortable with outbound calling, follow-ups, and sales conversion. Candidates who can manage customer records and maintain accurate Excel/CRM trackers. Candidates who demonstrate confidence, patience, ownership, and a result-oriented approach. Excellent English Communication is mandatory for this role.

Build relationships with prospective customers and identify new business opportunities. 
 Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Qualify leads based on business requirement, Salesforce requirement, decision-making authority, budget, timeline and company fit . Generate qualified opportunities for the Sales/Business Development team. Schedule discovery calls, product discussions, Salesforce demos and meetings. Provide complete prospect and opportunity information to the Sales team before handover. 
 CRM & Reporting Maintain accurate prospect and lead information in the CRM. Track calls, emails, LinkedIn interactions, follow-ups and lead status. Manage the sales pipeline and ensure timely follow-ups. Track lead generation and meeting conversion metrics. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales/lead-generation reports. 
 Required Skills & Experience 
 2 to 3 years of experience in Inside Sales, Lead Generation, SDR/BDR or Business Development. Experience in Salesforce product/solution sales or the Salesforce ecosystem is strongly preferred. Candidates with experience selling Salesforce CRM, Salesforce implementation, consulting, customization, integration, migration or support services will be preferred. Experience in B2B technology / SaaS / CRM / IT Services sales . Proven experience in international lead generation and outbound sales . Experience working with customers/prospects in Australia, New Zealand, APAC and/or India . Strong experience with cold calling, email outreach and LinkedIn prospecting . Ability to engage with CXOs, CIOs, CTOs, IT Heads, Sales Heads and other senior decision-makers . Good understanding of B2B sales processes and lead qualification. Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho or similar . Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo or similar tools is an advantage. Excellent spoken and written English communication skills. Strong objection-handling, negotiation and relationship-building skills. Self-motivated, target-oriented and comfortable working with international sales targets. Salesforce Knowledge Preferred The candidate should ideally have working knowledge of some of the following: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Service Cloud Experience Cloud Marketing Cloud Salesforce automation and customization Salesforce implementation and consulting services Salesforce integrations Salesforce migration Salesforce support and managed services Candidates who have previously sold Salesforce products, Salesforce implementation services or Salesforce consulting services will be given preference. Target Markets Experience in any of the following markets is highly desirable: India Australia New Zealand APAC / Asia-Pacific Candidates with proven experience generating B2B opportunities in Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) will be especially preferred. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Qualified Salesforce leads generated per month Outbound calls and prospecting activities Email and LinkedIn outreach Qualified meetings / discovery calls booked Lead-to-meeting conversion Meeting-to-opportunity conversion Salesforce sales pipeline generated Revenue opportunities generated Follow-up and CRM discipline Achievement of monthly and quarterly targets

You should be comfortable identifying companies with Salesforce/CRM requirements, reaching out to senior decision-makers, understanding their business challenges, qualifying opportunities and generating meetings for the Sales team. Salesforce ecosystem experience + International B2B Lead Generation + APAC/ANZ market exposure will be the key differentiators for this role. description:
Technical Sales Executive Adhesives | Coatings | Thermal Materials 30,000 Fixed + Commission | 50,000+ Earning Potential Company: Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. 
 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Travel across Gujarat & Maharashtra 
 Experience: 1–2 Years 
 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. – Chemical, Polymer, Chemistry or related fields 
 Reports to: Founder Build Your Career in Technical Sales & Advanced Materials Want a career where your technical knowledge can directly translate into business and income? Amatech Innovation is looking for a driven, technically curious and coachable Technical Sales Executive to join our growing team. This is not a conventional sales job. You will work directly with the Founder, meet OEMs and industrial customers, understand their technical challenges, recommend material solutions, coordinate product trials and convert successful technical engagements into commercial business. If you are ambitious, comfortable with field work and want to develop expertise in specialty adhesives, thermal management materials and protective coatings, this is an opportunity to build a strong technical-sales career from the ground up. About Amatech Innovation Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. is an Ahmedabad-based advanced materials technology company developing and manufacturing high-performance specialty materials for demanding industrial applications. Our key technology platforms include: Linkobond® – Specialty Adhesives Amasil® – Thermal Management Materials Amacoat® – Protective & Functional Coatings Custom-engineered material solutions Our products are used for applications across: EV & Batteries | Electronics | Electrical | Automotive | Pumps | LED | Industrial OEMs We are a lean, founder-driven company with strong technical and R&D capabilities, now expanding our technical sales and business development team. What You Will Do Your job is to understand the customer's problem, identify the right technical solution and turn the opportunity into business. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new OEM and industrial customers across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Prospect customers in EV/battery, electronics, electrical, automotive components, pumps, LED and industrial segments. Meet engineers, R&D teams, plant personnel, purchase teams and business owners. Understand customer applications, specifications, performance requirements and material challenges. Recommend suitable Amatech products or coordinate with the technical team for customized solutions. Conduct technical product presentations and customer discussions. Coordinate samples, trials, testing and technical follow-ups. Convert successful trials into commercial orders and repeat business. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline. Maintain systematic records of customer visits, samples, trials, quotations and opportunities. Work with existing channel partners and support expansion of the distribution network. Achieve agreed activity, customer acquisition and revenue targets. Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to the Founder and R&D team. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for someone who is technically curious, commercially driven and willing to learn. Preferred Profile Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Chemistry or related disciplines. 1–2 years of experience in technical sales, application engineering, application support or industrial sales. Experience with adhesives, coatings, sealants, potting compounds, thermal materials, industrial chemicals or electronics/electrical components will be an advantage. Freshers with strong technical fundamentals and genuine interest in technical sales are welcome. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Comfortable discussing technical subjects with engineers and customers. Willingness to travel extensively across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Good English and Hindi communication; Gujarati or Marathi will be an advantage. Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. Attitude Matters More Than Experience We are particularly looking for someone who is: Driven • Coachable • Curious • Persistent • Customer-focused • Energetic • Comfortable with field work • Willing to learn If you want a desk-based 9-to-5 job, this role may not be for you. If you want to meet customers, learn technology, solve industrial problems, develop business and grow rapidly, we want to hear from you. Compensation & Earning Potential 30,000/month Fixed + Attractive Commission Your earning potential is linked to your performance. 30,000/month fixed salary Attractive commission on collected sales Performance-based incentives Quarterly bonuses Travel reimbursement Mobile allowance 50,000+ monthly earning potential for strong performers Performance-linked increase in fixed compensation Opportunity to take ownership of important customers, territories and accounts Performance = Growth At Amatech, we don't want salespeople who simply complete their daily activities. We want people who create customers and generate business. A strong performer who consistently develops customers and delivers collected sales can target 50,000+ monthly earnings, with significantly higher earning potential as the business grows. Your career progression will be based primarily on what you achieve — not simply how long you have been with the company. Why Join Amatech? Learn Advanced Materials Technology Gain practical exposure to specialty adhesives, thermal management materials, potting compounds, coatings and application engineering. Work Directly With the Founder Learn customer engagement, technical selling, negotiation and business development directly from company leadership. Work With Real Industrial Customers Interact with OEMs, engineers, R&D teams, plant heads and purchase teams rather than relying only on conventional distribution sales. Build Something From the Ground Up You will not simply inherit a territory. You will help build Amatech's technical sales function and customer base. High Performance = High Earning Potential Your income can grow significantly through commission and performance incentives. Fast Career Growth In a growing company, capable performers can take on responsibility much faster than in a traditional large organization. Build an Indian Advanced Materials Company Be part of a team developing and commercializing high-performance, India-origin materials for global industrial applications. Location & Travel Base: Ahmedabad, Gujarat The role involves regular travel across Gujarat and Maharashtra for customer development, technical meetings, product trials and business development. How to Apply Send your updated CV to: careers@amatech.co.in or info@amatech.co.in Subject: Technical Sales Executive – Amatech Please mention your current location, qualification, experience and notice period in your application. If you are ambitious, technically curious and ready to build your career in technical sales — we want to hear from you.

About House of EdTech House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP) is a high-growth, multi-entity EdTech organization focused on delivering large-scale, outcome-driven professional education across high-impact domains including Artificial Intelligence, Finance, Data, Product Management, and Business Skills.  Reports to: Founder Build Your Career in Technical Sales & Advanced Materials Want a career where your technical knowledge can directly translate into business and income? Amatech Innovation is looking for a driven, technically curious and coachable Technical Sales Executive to join our growing team. This is not a conventional sales job. You will work directly with the Founder, meet OEMs and industrial customers, understand their technical challenges, recommend material solutions, coordinate product trials and convert successful technical engagements into commercial business. If you are ambitious, comfortable with field work and want to develop expertise in specialty adhesives, thermal management materials and protective coatings, this is an opportunity to build a strong technical-sales career from the ground up. About Amatech Innovation Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. is an Ahmedabad-based advanced materials technology company developing and manufacturing high-performance specialty materials for demanding industrial applications. Our key technology platforms include: Linkobond® – Specialty Adhesives Amasil® – Thermal Management Materials Amacoat® – Protective & Functional Coatings Custom-engineered material solutions Our products are used for applications across: EV & Batteries | Electronics | Electrical | Automotive | Pumps | LED | Industrial OEMs We are a lean, founder-driven company with strong technical and R&D capabilities, now expanding our technical sales and business development team. What You Will Do Your job is to understand the customer's problem, identify the right technical solution and turn the opportunity into business. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new OEM and industrial customers across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Prospect customers in EV/battery, electronics, electrical, automotive components, pumps, LED and industrial segments. Meet engineers, R&D teams, plant personnel, purchase teams and business owners. Understand customer applications, specifications, performance requirements and material challenges. Recommend suitable Amatech products or coordinate with the technical team for customized solutions. Conduct technical product presentations and customer discussions. Coordinate samples, trials, testing and technical follow-ups. Convert successful trials into commercial orders and repeat business. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline. Maintain systematic records of customer visits, samples, trials, quotations and opportunities. Work with existing channel partners and support expansion of the distribution network. Achieve agreed activity, customer acquisition and revenue targets. Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to the Founder and R&D team. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for someone who is technically curious, commercially driven and willing to learn. Preferred Profile Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Chemistry or related disciplines. 1–2 years of experience in technical sales, application engineering, application support or industrial sales. Experience with adhesives, coatings, sealants, potting compounds, thermal materials, industrial chemicals or electronics/electrical components will be an advantage. Freshers with strong technical fundamentals and genuine interest in technical sales are welcome. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Comfortable discussing technical subjects with engineers and customers. Willingness to travel extensively across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Good English and Hindi communication; Gujarati or Marathi will be an advantage. Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. Attitude Matters More Than Experience We are particularly looking for someone who is: Driven • Coachable • Curious • Persistent • Customer-focused • Energetic • Comfortable with field work • Willing to learn If you want a desk-based 9-to-5 job, this role may not be for you. If you want to meet customers, learn technology, solve industrial problems, develop business and grow rapidly, we want to hear from you. Compensation & Earning Potential 30,000/month Fixed + Attractive Commission Your earning potential is linked to your performance. 30,000/month fixed salary Attractive commission on collected sales Performance-based incentives Quarterly bonuses Travel reimbursement Mobile allowance 50,000+ monthly earning potential for strong performers Performance-linked increase in fixed compensation Opportunity to take ownership of important customers, territories and accounts Performance = Growth At Amatech, we don't want salespeople who simply complete their daily activities. We want people who create customers and generate business. A strong performer who consistently develops customers and delivers collected sales can target 50,000+ monthly earnings, with significantly higher earning potential as the business grows. Your career progression will be based primarily on what you achieve — not simply how long you have been with the company. Why Join Amatech? Learn Advanced Materials Technology Gain practical exposure to specialty adhesives, thermal management materials, potting compounds, coatings and application engineering. Work Directly With the Founder Learn customer engagement, technical selling, negotiation and business development directly from company leadership. Work With Real Industrial Customers Interact with OEMs, engineers, R&D teams, plant heads and purchase teams rather than relying only on conventional distribution sales. Build Something From the Ground Up You will not simply inherit a territory. You will help build Amatech's technical sales function and customer base. High Performance = High Earning Potential Your income can grow significantly through commission and performance incentives. Fast Career Growth In a growing company, capable performers can take on responsibility much faster than in a traditional large organization. Build an Indian Advanced Materials Company Be part of a team developing and commercializing high-performance, India-origin materials for global industrial applications. Location & Travel Base: Ahmedabad, Gujarat The role involves regular travel across Gujarat and Maharashtra for customer development, technical meetings, product trials and business development. How to Apply Send your updated CV to: careers@amatech.co.in or info@amatech.co.in Subject: Technical Sales Executive – Amatech Please mention your current location, qualification, experience and notice period in your application. If you are ambitious, technically curious and ready to build your career in technical sales — we want to hear from you.

description:
Role: SALES MANAGER 
 Role Definition 
The Senior Sales Manager drives revenue growth by developing and executing sales strategies, overseeing the entire sales process for efficiency, and building strong relationships with clients and industry stakeholders. They ensure exceptional customer service and resolve issues promptly to maintain high levels of client satisfaction.
 
 Responsibility Deliverable 
 Sales Revenue Growth : Develop and implement effective strategies, plans, and pitches to drive revenue growth and maximize client value.
 Sales Audit : Conduct regular audits, evaluate team performance against targets, track KPIs, and provide targeted training for improvement.
 Lead Nurturing : Qualify leads, implement effective follow-up strategies, manage objections, and ensure successful lead conversions.
 Networking & Relationship Building : Build strong industry relationships, customize sales approaches based on client needs, and resolve issues promptly for client satisfaction.
 
 
 
 
 Tasks & Activities 
 
 
 
 1. Sales Revenue Growth Rate 
 Sales Strategy Development : Create and implement strategies to drive revenue growth and meet/exceed sales targets.
 Sales Planning & Strategy Execution : Develop sales plans (weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly) to ensure continuous growth.

 Holistic Offer Presentation : Present offers using a psychological, physical, and financial approach to maximize value for clients. 
 2. Sales Audit 
 Timely Sales Audits : Conduct regular audits of the sales team's performance.
 Evaluate Targets : Review individual and team performance against sales targets.
 Track KPI & KRA Performance : Monitor KPIs and KRAs to assess productivity and identify areas for improvement.
 Training & Development : Provide skill-based training based on audit findings to enhance team performance.
 
 3. Lead Nurturing 
 Lead Qualification : Ensure high-quality lead qualification based on defined criteria.
 Follow-Up Process : Implement follow-up strategies to keep leads engaged through the sales funnel.
 Objection Handling & Management : Equip the team with tactics to handle and manage customer objections.
 Lead Conversion & Closing : Drive lead nurturing to successful deal closure, ensuring long-term customer relationships.
 4. Networking and Relationship Building 
 Client Need Assessment & Customization : Customize sales strategies based on client assessments and needs.
 
 Networking : Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, industry players, and potential partners.
 Customer Relationship Management : Maintain and grow customer relationships post-sale to ensure satisfaction and repeat business.
 Problem Solving : Address and resolve customer issues swiftly to maintain positive relationships.
 
 
 
 
 Measurement Metrics 
 Revenue Total Sales Revenue : 100 crore

Job Title: Area Sales Manager (ASM) FMCG (Food Industry)

 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Area Sales Manager (ASM) to handle sales operations in the assigned territory. The candidate should have strong experience in the FMCG Food Industry and should be capable of managing distributors, leading a sales team, expanding the market, and achieving sales targets. 
 Key Responsibilities Achieve monthly and yearly sales targets for the assigned area. Appoint, manage, and develop distributors and retailers. Expand business in new markets and uncovered areas. Maintain strong relationships with existing distributors and retail partners. Lead, guide, and motivate the Territory Sales Team to achieve business goals. Monitor team performance and conduct regular market visits. Ensure proper market coverage and productive sales calls. Plan and execute new product launches in the assigned territory. Analyze sales performance and market trends through SFA reports. Collect customer and market feedback to improve business performance. Ensure availability of all product SKUs in the market. Maintain FIFO (First In First Out) at distributor and depot level. Participate in local exhibitions, promotional activities, and market campaigns. Coordinate with Head Office and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports. Ensure outlet data is updated and validated regularly. Monitor journey plans of the sales team and ensure proper market execution. 
 Candidate Requirements Graduation in any discipline. 10–15 years of sales experience in the FMCG Food Industry. Minimum 2–3 years of experience as an Area Sales Manager (ASM). Strong distributor and channel sales management experience. Good leadership and team handling skills. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Knowledge of SFA applications, MS Excel, and basic computer operations. Ability to analyze sales data and prepare reports. Good understanding of the local market and local language. Must possess a valid driving license and be willing to travel extensively. 
 Preferred Skills Strong leadership and decision-making ability. Target-driven and result-oriented approach. Excellent planning and execution skills. Good problem-solving and relationship management skills. Ability to work independently and manage a team effectively.
